results.name: heldout-unanswerable-how-did-the-loss-reserve-for-claim-12312702-chan-ea10b3
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 1 row in 4 ms
answer.sql:
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    ca.Claim_Amount,
    CASE
      WHEN ca.Event_Date IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LENGTH(CAST(ca.Event_Date AS VARCHAR)) = 8 THEN CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(CAST(ca.Event_Date AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS DATE)
      WHEN LENGTH(CAST(ca.Event_Date AS VARCHAR)) >= 10 THEN TRY_CAST(CAST(ca.Event_Date AS VARCHAR) AS DATE)
      ELSE CAST(DATE '1970-01-01' + TRY_CAST(ca.Event_Date AS INTEGER) AS DATE)
    END AS event_dt
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount AS ca
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve AS lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim AS c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE c.Company_Claim_Number = 12312702
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    Company_Claim_Number,
    Claim_Identifier,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', event_dt) AS reserve_month,
    SUM(Claim_Amount) AS loss_reserve_amount
  FROM parsed
  GROUP BY Company_Claim_Number, Claim_Identifier, DATE_TRUNC('month', event_dt)
)
SELECT
  Company_Claim_Number,
  Claim_Identifier,
  reserve_month,
  loss_reserve_amount,
  loss_reserve_amount - LAG(loss_reserve_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY Claim_Identifier ORDER BY reserve_month) AS change_from_prior_month
FROM monthly
ORDER BY Claim_Identifier, reserve_month
LIMIT 500
